title: Charter receives final state approval to buy Cox for $21.9B after making concessions to California regulators, including low-cost internet for some households (Patience Haggin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Patience Haggin / Wall Street Journal: Charter receives final state approval to buy Cox for $21.9B after making concessions to California regulators, including low-cost internet for some households — Cable and broadband providers receive regulatory clearance from California after agreeing to some concessions on affordability
